insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 30 times in a single test, suggesting potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple refresh calls to optimize performance.

insights.title: UI Actions Trigger API Calls
insights.description: User actions such as logging in and generating reports consistently trigger specific API calls, indicating a strong UI-API relationship.
insights.recommendation: Document the UI-API interactions for better understanding of user workflows.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully with no failures recorded.
• The most frequent API call was for refreshing budget controls, indicating a potential area for optimization.
• User authentication processes were consistently triggered across all workflows, ensuring secure access.
• Report generation workflows showed a strong correlation between UI actions and API calls.
• No latency issues were detected, with all endpoints performing within acceptable limits.
• Continuous monitoring of API call frequencies is recommended to identify potential inefficiencies.
